```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(pheatmap)
library(grid)
library(svglite)
library(ggpubr)
```

read in data

```{r}
key.long <- readRDS("../../data/derived/clinical_manuscript.rds")$samples_long
met <- read_excel("../data/raw/urine-metabolomics/Dan Urine Anthocyanin 11-10-2022.xlsx", sheet = "concentration ng mL") %>%
  filter(!is.na(`21-V2`))
```

```{r}
met <- met %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-...1), ~as.numeric(.)) %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-...1), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 2:81, 
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "value",
    values_transform = ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", "", .x))
  ) %>%
  rename("metabolite" = `...1`) %>%
  separate(Sample, c("Subject.Number", "v")) %>%
  mutate(v = toupper(v))
```

prep key

```{r}
key.long <- key.long %>%
  mutate(v =  toupper(substr(timepoints, 11, 12)),
         v = ifelse(v == "-V", toupper(substr(timepoints, 12, 13)), v),
         Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number)) %>%
  select(Subject.Number, v, Timepoint) 

# join to met 
met <- met %>%
  left_join(key.long)
```

Note: key.long doesn't include participants 84, 101, 102 that are present in metabolomics data Would like to check that the timepoint key includes all participants as it was developed early on...

plot metabolites

```{r}
met$Timepoint <- factor(met$Timepoint, levels=c("rP", "tP", "rB", "tB"))

met %>%
  filter(!is.na(Timepoint)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Timepoint, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(metabolite ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("ng/mL") + 
  theme(base.size = 10) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("../figures/metabolomics_boxplot.png", dev="png", height = 6, width = 5, dpi = 400)
```

```{r}
# Rename levels for legend clarity
met_brb <- met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB")) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("rB", "tB")),

# Plot

  )

```
```{r}
rb_tb_wide_all <- met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB")) %>%
  filter(metabolite != "cy glc sulf") %>%
  select(metabolite, Subject.Number, Timepoint, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(change = tB - rB)

heat_data_all1 <- rb_tb_wide_all %>%
  select(Subject.Number, metabolite, change) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metabolite, values_from = change) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Subject.Number") %>%
  as.matrix()

heat_data_z <- scale(heat_data_all1)

pheatmap(
  heat_data_z,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("purple4", "white", "red3"))(100),
  labels_row = rep("", nrow(heat_data_z))
)
```

```{r}
# Create the heatmap and store it
p <- pheatmap(
  heat_data_z,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("red3", "white", "purple4"))(100),
  silent = TRUE  # Prevents automatic plotting so we can capture it
)

# Open SVG device
svglite::svglite("../figures/metabolomics_heatmap.svg", height = 4, width = 6)

# Draw the saved gtable to the device
grid::grid.draw(p$gtable)

# Close device
dev.off()

```



```{r}
# Ensure correct timepoint order
met$Timepoint <- factor(met$Timepoint, levels = c("rP", "tP", "rB", "tB"))

# Run Wilcoxon test: rB vs tB for each metabolite
sig_mets <- met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB")) %>%
  group_by(metabolite) %>%
  summarise(p.value = tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(value[Timepoint == "rB"], value[Timepoint == "tB"])$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )) %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  pull(metabolite)

# Subset met for significant metabolites only
met_sig <- met %>%
  filter(metabolite %in% sig_mets)

met_comp <- met_sig %>% filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB"))

ggplot(met_comp, aes(x = Timepoint, y = value, group = Subject.Number)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Timepoint), size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolite, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("rB" = "gold", "tB" = "purple")) +
  labs(title = "Compliance Check: Metabolite Increase Post BRB",
       y = "ng/mL") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)

```

```{r}
# Filter only rB and tB
met_rb_tb <- met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB"))

# Perform Wilcoxon test for each metabolite
wilcox_rb_tb <- met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB")) %>%
  select(Subject.Number, metabolite, Timepoint, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = value) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rB), !is.na(tB)) %>%
  group_by(metabolite) %>%
  summarise(
    p.value = wilcox.test(rB, tB, paired = TRUE)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    significant = ifelse(p.adj < 0.05, "yes", "no")
  )

# View significant results
wilcox_rb_tb %>% filter(significant == "yes")


```

```{r}
# Get significant metabolite names
sig_metabs <- wilcox_rb_tb %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  pull(metabolite)

# Subset original data
rb_tb_data <- met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB"),
         metabolite %in% sig_metabs)

rb_tb_wide <- rb_tb_data %>%
  select(metabolite, Subject.Number, Timepoint, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(change = tB - rB)
write.csv(rb_tb_wide,
          file = "../data/derived/rb_tb_wide.csv")
```

```{r}
# Loop through each metabolite and plot the changes
for (metab in unique(rb_tb_wide$metabolite)) {
  p <- rb_tb_wide %>%
    filter(metabolite == metab) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(Subject.Number), y = change)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
    labs(title = paste("Change in", metab, "per participant"),
         x = "Subject", y = "Change (tB - rB)") +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p)  # shows the plot if interactive
  ggsave(paste0("../figures/", gsub(" ", "_", metab), "_barplot.png"), plot = p, width = 6, height = 4)
}

```

```{r}
# Filter for rB and tB timepoints only
met_rb_tb <- met_sig %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB"))

# Get one row per Subject.Number × metabolite with rB and tB
met_diff <- met_rb_tb %>%
  select(Subject.Number, metabolite, Timepoint, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = value) %>%
```

```{r}
# Create matrix: rows = participants, columns = metabolites
heat_data <- rb_tb_wide %>%
  select(Subject.Number, metabolite, change) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metabolite, values_from = change) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Subject.Number") %>%
  as.matrix()

pheatmap(
  heat_data,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("purple4", "white", "red2"))(100))


```

```{r}
heat_data_sig <- rb_tb_wide %>%
  filter(metabolite %in% sig_mets) %>%
  select(Subject.Number, metabolite, change) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metabolite, values_from = change) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Subject.Number") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Perform hierarchical clustering on participants
row_dist <- dist(heat_data_sig)
row_clust <- hclust(row_dist)

# Cut dendrogram into 3 clusters
cluster_assignments <- cutree(row_clust, k = 3)

# Create annotation dataframe
compliance_cluster_df <- data.frame(
  Subject.Number = rownames(heat_data_sig),
  compliance_cluster = as.factor(cluster_assignments)
)
rownames(compliance_cluster_df) <- compliance_cluster_df$Subject.Number
compliance_cluster_df <- compliance_cluster_df[, "compliance_cluster", drop = FALSE]

pheatmap(
  heat_data_sig,
  annotation_row = compliance_cluster_df,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,  # cluster metabolites
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100))

```

```{r}
# Cut into 3 clusters
cluster_assignments <- cutree(row_clust, k = 3)

# Merge clusters 1 and 2 into one group
merged_clusters <- ifelse(cluster_assignments %in% c(1, 2), "Responder", "Non-responder")

# Build new annotation dataframe
compliance_cluster_df <- data.frame(BRB_response = merged_clusters)
rownames(compliance_cluster_df) <- rownames(heat_data_sig)
annotation_colors <- list(
  BRB_response = c("Responder" = "skyblue", "Non-responder" = "gold")
)
pheatmap(
  heat_data_sig,
  annotation_row = compliance_cluster_df,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("purple4", "white", "red2"))(100))

```
```{r}
write.csv(
  compliance_cluster_df,
  file = "../data/derived/compliance_cluster_df.csv")
```


```{r}
# New clustering WITHOUT cy glc sulf
heat_data_sig_no_cy <- rb_tb_wide %>%
  filter(metabolite %in% sig_mets) %>%
  filter(metabolite != "cy glc sulf") %>%
  select(Subject.Number, metabolite, change) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metabolite, values_from = change) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Subject.Number") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Scale metabolites
heat_data_sig_no_cy_z <- scale(heat_data_sig_no_cy)

# Cluster participants into 2 groups
row_clust_no_cy <- hclust(dist(heat_data_sig_no_cy_z))
cluster_assignments_no_cy <- cutree(row_clust_no_cy, k = 2)

# Find which cluster has the higher average polyphenol increase
cluster_df <- data.frame(
  Subject.Number = rownames(heat_data_sig_no_cy_z),
  cluster = cluster_assignments_no_cy
)
cluster_df$Subject.Number <- as.numeric(cluster_df$Subject.Number)

rb_tb_cluster <- rb_tb_wide %>%
  filter(metabolite %in% sig_mets) %>%
  filter(metabolite != "cy glc sulf") %>%
  left_join(cluster_df, by = "Subject.Number")

cluster_summary <- rb_tb_cluster %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(mean_change = mean(change, na.rm = TRUE))

print(cluster_summary)

responder_cluster <- cluster_summary$cluster[
  which.max(cluster_summary$mean_change)
]

# Assign responder label based on higher mean polyphenol increase
merged_clusters_no_cy <- ifelse(
  cluster_assignments_no_cy == responder_cluster,
  "Responder_no_cyglcsulf",
  "Non_responder_no_cyglcsulf"
)

# New dataframe
compliance_cluster_df_no_cy <- data.frame(
  BRB_response_no_cyglcsulf = merged_clusters_no_cy
)

rownames(compliance_cluster_df_no_cy) <- rownames(heat_data_sig_no_cy_z)

# Save with a NEW name
write.csv(
  compliance_cluster_df_no_cy,
  file = "../data/derived/compliance_cluster_df_no_cyglcsulf.csv"
)
```

```{r}
# Pick one non-significant metabolite
no_change_met <- wilcox_rb_tb %>%
  filter(p.adj > 0.5) %>%
  filter(metabolite %in% unique(met$metabolite)) %>%
  filter(!metabolite %in% c("cy rut", "cy xyrut")) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(metabolite)

# Set desired facet order
met_order <- c("cy rut", "cy xyrut", no_change_met)

# Plot
met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB"),
         metabolite %in% met_order) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = recode(Timepoint, "rB" = "Pre-BRB", "tB" = "Post-BRB"),
    metabolite = factor(metabolite, levels = met_order)  # enforce facet order
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Timepoint, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +  # show individual points
  facet_wrap(~ metabolite, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "", y = "ng/mL") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9)

ggsave("../figures/metabolomics_3boxplot.svg", height = 4, width = 6)

```

```{r}
# Define comparisons (Pre-BRB vs Post-BRB for each metabolite)
comparisons <- list(c("Pre-BRB", "Post-BRB"))

met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB"),
         metabolite %in% met_order) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = recode(Timepoint, "rB" = "Pre-BRB", "tB" = "Post-BRB"),
    metabolite = factor(metabolite, levels = met_order)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Timepoint, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolite, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "", y = "(ng/mL)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1)) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = comparisons, 
    method = "wilcox.test", 
    label = "p.signif"     # <-- asterisks instead of raw p-values
  )

ggsave("../figures/metabolomics_3boxplot1.svg", height = 4, width = 6)

```

```{r}
comparisons <- list(c("Pre-BRB", "Post-BRB"),c("Pre-Placebo", "Post-Placebo"))

met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB", "rP", "tP"),
         metabolite %in% met_order) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = recode(Timepoint,
                       "rB" = "Pre-BRB",  "tB" = "Post-BRB",
                       "rP" = "Pre-Placebo", "tP" = "Post-Placebo"),
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint,
                       levels = c("Pre-Placebo","Post-Placebo","Pre-BRB","Post-BRB")),
    metabolite = factor(metabolite, levels = met_order)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Timepoint, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolite, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "", y = "(ng/mL)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))+
  stat_compare_means(
  comparisons = comparisons,
  method = "wilcox.test",
  method.args = list(paired = TRUE),
  label = "p.signif"
)
ggsave("../figures/metabolomics_3boxplot_brb.svg", height = 4, width = 6)
```
